'''Mnesus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who created a number of biological experiments during his career. He owned several laboratories during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mnesus was first mentioned in the Bioanalysis crew skill mission "A Sith Lord's Work" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. With Game Update 4.1, the mission was made available to both factions, and Mnesus changed to a scientist named [[Jav Mensor]].
